mapper.select: SELECT cv.id, cv.cause, cv.create_id, cv.create_time, cv.next_deal_id, cv.total_amount, cv.status, ce.name AS creator_name, ce.post AS creator_post, de.name AS dealer_name, de.post AS dealer_post FROM claim_voucher cv LEFT JOIN employee ce ON ce.id = cv.create_id LEFT JOIN employee de ON de.id = cv.next_deal_id WHERE cv.id = #{id}

SELECT cv.id, cv.cause, cv.create_id, cv.create_time, cv.next_deal_id, cv.total_amount, cv.status, ce.name AS creator_name, ce.post AS creator_post, de.name AS dealer_name, de.post AS dealer_post FROM claim_voucher cv LEFT JOIN employee ce ON ce.id = cv.create_id LEFT JOIN employee de ON de.id = cv.next_deal_id WHERE cv.create_id = #{createId} ORDER BY cv.create_time DESC
